functional_duplicates.rationale: Pseudo declares messageText as input but live code (wf43-n07) and all runtime executions use messageContent as the field carrying the user's message body.

subagent_notes: WF-02 is a pure passthrough caller (mappingMode=passthrough, no set_assignments), so no dead_pass or caller_missing_required findings are emitted per passthrough special rules. The pseudo field messageText is a functional duplicate of the live field messageContent — the canonical name is messageContent as confirmed by all runtime executions and static code. userId appears in the pseudo contract but is never read directly by WF-43 live code; it travels through the spread payload to sub-workflows (WF-44, WF-45, WF-47) implicitly via passthrough, so it is retained as optional rather than dropped. userStatus is not present in the WF-02 trigger payload's top level but is added by WF-25 before downstream intent checks, so it is not a required input to WF-43 itself.
